name: 07050 · Orange, NJ
findings: ZIP 07050 (Orange) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07050 (Orange) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07050 (Orange) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
